collections.heading: Collections
collections.description: Keep related downloads together, without downloading the same file twice.
collections.folder_hint: Existing files stay where they are. A linked file can belong to more than one collection.
collections.name: Collection name
collections.metadata_only: Changing or removing a collection never moves or deletes its media files.
collections.preservation_hint: Clearing download history keeps collections, memberships, batches, and media files.

collections.empty_items: No files in this collection yet
collections.empty_items_hint: Approved items appear here as they join the queue. You can add another set with Collect URLs.
batch.heading: Collect a set of URLs
batch.description: Choose a topic and optional publication dates. Preview first; nothing downloads until you approve.
batch.purpose_placeholder: What do you want to keep, and why?
batch.urls_hint: One URL per line, up to {count}. Playlist and channel URLs are not accepted here.
batch.preview_safe: No downloads or folders are created yet.
batch.date_warning: Known out-of-range items cannot be selected. Select an unknown-date item only if you accept that its publication date cannot be verified.

batch.too_many: This NAS accepts up to {count} URLs per batch. Split the list and try again.
batch.invalid_dates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
connect.heading: AI Connect
connect.description: Your AI researches. You approve. This NAS keeps the files together.
connect.new_hint: Give each client its own token so you can revoke access independently.
connect.name_placeholder: For example, Claude Code on my laptop
connect.token_once_hint: This is the only time the token is shown. Keep it in your client's secure settings; the NAS stores only its hash.
connect.setup_hint: Use the same NAS address as this page. No extra port or companion service is needed.
connect.http_warning: HTTP does not encrypt your token. Use it only on a trusted LAN; use HTTPS or a VPN for remote access. Some clients require HTTPS.
connect.research_hint: Your AI client searches the web and gathers direct media URLs. This server does not search the web for you.
connect.review_hint: Check the candidates, publication dates, existing files, and suggested collection. Unknown dates need an explicit choice.
connect.approve_hint: One approved commit creates a stable batch. Existing files are linked, not copied or downloaded again.
connect.example_prompt: Find publicly available videos I am allowed to download about urban gardening, published this year. Preview up to 10 direct URLs for a NAS collection. Show me dates and duplicates, and wait for my approval before committing.
connect.access_hint: Read the library and collection metadata, inspect the queue, and submit approved download requests.
connect.no_delete: MCP exposes no file-delete tool and accepts no arbitrary filesystem path. Revoking a token blocks future calls, but does not cancel work already approved.
connect.no_connections_hint: Create a named token above, then add this endpoint to your AI client.
connect.created: Connection created. Copy the token before leaving this page.
connect.revoke_confirm: Revoke “{name}”? This token will stop working immediately. Previously approved downloads will continue.
connect.config_env_hint: Set YDLNAS_MCP_TOKEN in the environment that launches your client. Replace the sample NAS address only if the client reaches this NAS through a different address.
connect.config_vscode_hint: For VS Code's own chat: it prompts for and securely stores your token. Start youtube-dl-nas with MCP: List Servers. Agent Host needs an environment-based header instead; see the guide.
connect.config_header_hint: Replace YOUR_MCP_TOKEN with the token shown once above. Keep this user-level configuration private; do not commit it to a repository.
connect.config_claude_hint: Set YDLNAS_MCP_TOKEN in your shell before running this command. Check the connection with /mcp inside Claude Code.

failure.storage_permission.reason: The container cannot write to the download volume.
failure.storage_permission.action: Check the volume mount plus PUID, PGID, and UMASK, then retry.
failure.auth_required.reason: The source requires a signed-in session or fresh cookies.
failure.auth_required.action: Upload a current Netscape cookies file in Options, or check the configured external mount.
failure.rate_limited.reason: The source temporarily limited this NAS.
failure.rate_limited.action: Wait before retrying, or check the configured proxy and cookies.
failure.format_unavailable.reason: The selected output is not available for this source.
failure.format_unavailable.action: Retry with Best, or choose another audio or resolution profile.
failure.unsupported_url.reason: yt-dlp does not recognize this source URL.
failure.unsupported_url.action: Check the URL and confirm the site is supported by the current yt-dlp release.
failure.network.reason: The NAS could not reach the source reliably.
failure.network.action: Check DNS, internet access, and proxy settings, then retry.
failure.postprocessing.action: Check container logs for the FFmpeg step, available space, and file permissions.
failure.extractor.reason: The source changed and the current extractor could not read it.
failure.extractor.action: Confirm the hourly yt-dlp updater succeeded, then retry.
failure.source_blocked.reason: The source led to a private or local network destination.
failure.source_blocked.action: Use a public URL, or explicitly enable trusted private sources in the container configuration.
failure.unknown.reason: The download ended before a specific cause could be identified.
failure.unknown.action: Retry once, then inspect the sanitized container logs if it fails again.
